description: Baseline metric thresholds for the 23-case smoke eval (propose/confirm booking architecture). strict=true metrics require every individual case score to equal 1.0; strict=false metrics require the mean across cases to be >= min_allowed. Judge and Ragas LLM is gemini-3.5-flash-lite (gemini-2.5-flash was deprecated for this account); booking.llm.reasoning_effort is medium. Ragas context precision now uses the hotel-tuned prompt in eval/evaluators/_rag_prompts.py, which scores a chunk as useful when it answers any one clause of a multi-part question, and skips turns whose reference is only the 'nothing matched' sentinel ([ragas].no_match_reference). min_allowed for rag_context_precision_mean and rag_faithfulness_mean matches the 206-case baseline (0.80 / 0.85); at n=18 scored turns this leaves less headroom than the 206-case set, so watch this one first if a run trips it.
